sentences.text_target: The manager sends an email to the team.
sentences.phonetic: ðə ˈmænɪdʒər sɛndz ən ˈiˌmeɪl tuː ðə tiːm.
sentences.text_native: Le responsable envoie un e-mail à l'équipe.

sentences.text_target: He wants to prepare a new project budget.
sentences.phonetic: hiː wɒnts tuː prɪˈpɛr ə nuː ˈprɑːdʒɛkt ˈbʌdʒət.
sentences.text_native: Il veut préparer un nouveau budget de projet.

sentences.text_target: The colleagues arrive in the office before nine.
sentences.phonetic: ðə ˈkɑːliːɡz əˈraɪv ɪn ði ˈɔːfɪs bɪˈfɔːr naɪn.
sentences.text_native: Les collègues arrivent au bureau avant neuf heures.

sentences.text_target: Everyone takes a seat around the large table.
sentences.phonetic: ˈɛvriˌwʌn teɪks ə siːt əˈraʊnd ðə lɑːrdʒ ˈteɪbəl.
sentences.text_native: Tout le monde prend place autour de la grande table.

sentences.text_target: The boss opens his laptop to show the agenda.
sentences.phonetic: ðə bɔːs ˈoʊpənz hɪz ˈlæpˌtɑːp tuː ʃoʊ ði əˈdʒɛndə.
sentences.text_native: Le patron ouvre son ordinateur portable pour montrer l'ordre du jour.

sentences.text_target: She explains the main goals for this month.
sentences.phonetic: ʃiː ɪkˈspleɪnz ðə meɪn ɡoʊlz fɔːr ðɪs mʌnθ.
sentences.text_native: Elle explique les principaux objectifs pour ce mois-ci.

sentences.text_target: A colleague asks a question about the client.
sentences.phonetic: ə ˈkɑːliːɡ æsks ə ˈkwɛstʃən əˈbaʊt ðə ˈklaɪənt.
sentences.text_native: Un collègue pose une question concernant le client.

sentences.text_target: They discuss the cost of the digital service.
sentences.phonetic: ðeɪ dɪˈskʌs ðə kɑːst ʌv ðə ˈdɪdʒɪtəl ˈsɜːrvɪs.
sentences.text_native: Ils discutent du coût du service numérique.

sentences.text_target: Another person suggests a different option.
sentences.phonetic: əˈnʌðər ˈpɜːrsən səɡˈdʒɛsts ə ˈdɪfərənt ˈɑːpʃən.
sentences.text_native: Une autre personne suggère une option différente.

sentences.text_target: The manager listens carefully to every comment.
sentences.phonetic: ðə ˈmænɪdʒər ˈlɪsənz ˈkɛrfəli tuː ˈɛvri ˈkɑːmɛnt.
sentences.text_native: Le responsable écoute attentivement chaque commentaire.

sentences.text_target: He writes important notes in his notebook.
sentences.phonetic: hiː raɪts ɪmˈpɔːrtənt noʊts ɪn hɪz ˈnoʊtˌbʊk.
sentences.text_native: Il écrit des notes importantes dans son carnet.

sentences.text_target: The group agrees on a practical solution.
sentences.phonetic: ðə ɡruːp əˈɡriːz ɑːn ə ˈpræktɪkəl səˈluːʃən.
sentences.text_native: Le groupe se met d'accord sur une solution pratique.

sentences.text_target: They check the printed documents on the desk.
sentences.phonetic: ðeɪ tʃɛk ðə ˈprɪntɪd ˈdɑːkjumənts ɑːn ðə dɛsk.
sentences.text_native: Ils vérifient les documents imprimés sur le bureau.

sentences.text_target: Someone shares a clever idea to improve quality.
sentences.phonetic: ˈsʌmˌwʌn ʃɛrz ə ˈklɛvər aɪˈdiːə tuː ɪmˈpruːv ˈkwɑːləti.
sentences.text_native: Quelqu'un partage une idée astucieuse pour améliorer la qualité.

sentences.text_target: The team reviews the market research data.
sentences.phonetic: ðə tiːm rɪˈvjuːz ðə ˈmɑːrkɪt rɪˈsɜːrtʃ ˈdeɪtə.
sentences.text_native: L'équipe examine les données d'étude de marché.

sentences.text_target: A chart shows an increase in recent sales.
sentences.phonetic: ə tʃɑːrt ʃoʊz ən ˈɪnˌkriːs ɪn ˈriːsənt seɪlz.
sentences.text_native: Un graphique montre une augmentation des ventes récentes.

sentences.text_target: They identify a minor issue with the schedule.
sentences.phonetic: ðeɪ aɪˈdɛntɪfaɪ ə ˈmaɪnər ˈɪʃuː wɪð ðə ˈskɛdʒul.
sentences.text_native: Ils identifient un problème mineur dans le calendrier.

sentences.text_target: The boss asks if anyone has any feedback.
sentences.phonetic: ðə bɔːs æsks ɪf ˈɛniˌwʌn hæz ˈɛni ˈfiːdˌbæk.
sentences.text_native: Le patron demande si quelqu'un a des retours.

sentences.text_target: A senior colleague provides helpful advice.
sentences.phonetic: ə ˈsiːnjər ˈkɑːliːɡ prəˈvaɪdz ˈhɛlpfəl ədˈvaɪs.
sentences.text_native: Un collègue senior fournit des conseils utiles.

sentences.text_target: Everyone agrees to follow the new plan.
sentences.phonetic: ˈɛvriˌwʌn əˈɡriːz tuː ˈfɑːloʊ ðə nuː plæn.
sentences.text_native: Tout le monde accepte de suivre le nouveau plan.

sentences.text_target: The manager outlines the next steps clearly.
sentences.phonetic: ðə ˈmænɪdʒər ˈaʊtˌlaɪnz ðə nɛkst stɛps ˈklɪrli.
sentences.text_native: Le responsable expose clairement les prochaines étapes.

sentences.text_target: They confirm the date for the next meeting.
sentences.phonetic: ðeɪ kənˈfɜːrm ðə deɪt fɔːr ðə nɛkst ˈmiːtɪŋ.
sentences.text_native: Ils confirment la date de la prochaine réunion.

sentences.text_target: All participants sign the attendance sheet.
sentences.phonetic: ɔːl pɑːrˈtɪsəpənts saɪn ði əˈtɛndəns ʃiːt.
sentences.text_native: Tous les participants signent la feuille de présence.

sentences.text_target: The atmosphere remains positive and quiet.
sentences.phonetic: ði ˈætməsˌfɪr rɪˈmeɪnz ˈpɑːzətɪv ənd ˈkwaɪət.
sentences.text_native: L'atmosphère reste positive et calme.

sentences.text_target: They finish discussing the final topic.
sentences.phonetic: ðeɪ ˈfɪnɪʃ dɪˈskʌsɪŋ ðə ˈfaɪnəl ˈtɑːpɪk.
sentences.text_native: Ils finissent de discuter du dernier sujet.

sentences.text_target: The boss thanks everyone for their hard work.
sentences.phonetic: ðə bɔːs θæŋks ˈɛvriˌwʌn fɔːr ðɛr hɑːrd wɜːrk.
sentences.text_native: Le patron remercie tout le monde pour leur travail acharné.

sentences.text_target: People close their laptops and pack their folders.
sentences.phonetic: ˈpiːpəl kloʊz ðɛr ˈlæpˌtɑːps ənd pæk ðɛr ˈfoʊldərz.
sentences.text_native: Les gens ferment leurs ordinateurs portables et rangent leurs dossiers.

sentences.text_target: Colleagues smile and say goodbye in the room.
sentences.phonetic: ˈkɑːliːɡz smaɪl ənd seɪ ɡʊdˈbaɪ ɪn ðə ruːm.
sentences.text_native: Les collègues sourient et se disent au revoir dans la pièce.

sentences.text_target: They leave the office through the glass door.
sentences.phonetic: ðeɪ liːv ði ˈɔːfɪs θruː ðə ɡlæs dɔːr.
sentences.text_native: Ils quittent le bureau par la porte vitrée.

sentences.text_target: Everyone returns to their desk for the afternoon.
sentences.phonetic: ˈɛvriˌwʌn rɪˈtɜːrnz tuː ðɛr dɛsk fɔːr ði ˈæftərˌnuːn.
sentences.text_native: Tout le monde retourne à son bureau pour l'après-midi.
